---
title: browser.lol
---
These tests run against beta only (https://beta.browser.lol): never production. Beta's data is disposable and is
reset by every push to beta, so a test may create sessions and accounts there.

- Secrets are typed by the tool (`qa type --secret NAME`), never pasted into a command or a message.
- Mail goes to the cell's own address (`qa address`), never to a shared one.
- No real payments: the plans are looked at, never bought.
